mathematical_results: In the stated scalar polynomial class, z^p conjugate(z)^q has phase weight p−q. Equating phase characters and polynomial coefficients leaves only p=q+1; F(conjugate(z))=conjugate(F(z)) then makes each surviving coefficient real. Thus F(z)=z h(|z|²) with h real polynomial, and three is the lowest nonlinear total degree.

unitary_absorption_criterion: For A=Ψ† (N by d), UA=AV for one d-dimensional unitary V iff (UA)(UA)†=AA†, i.e. UGU†=G. Necessity is immediate. For sufficiency, equality of column Grams of A† and A†U† makes A†x ↦ A†U†x a well-defined isometry on ran(A†); extend it unitarily as V† and take adjoints. No full-rank assumption is needed. For U=exp(−iτH) with Hermitian H, τ=1/4 and spectrum in [−1,1], distinct eigenvalues have distinct phases, so U and H have identical spectral projectors and [U,G]=0 iff [H,G]=0.
phase_gauge_limit: For a fixed diagonal token unitary D, DUA=AV iff DUGU†D†=G. Such a D is invisible after coordinatewise squaring, so a nonzero ordinary commutator alone cannot reject absorption up to token phases. Even exclusion of every such D rules out only this common unitary reparametrization up to fixed phases; it does not exclude query-dependent matching of normalized probabilities or prove a coordinate ceiling violation.
cheap_diagnostic: On the valid tokens of each prespecified sample, compute max_t ||(UA)_{t,:}||²−||A_{t,:}||² in absolute value (take the absolute difference before the maximum). These row norms give the diagonals of UGU† and G without a new eigensolve. A discrepancy exceeding a predeclared numerical error tolerance witnesses failure of diagonal-unitary equivalence; linear transport supplies a zero-residual control. A null result is inconclusive. This label-blind diagnostic tests neither utility nor probability-region escape and should not enter the task gate.
formal_single_seed_scientific_assessment: Preserve screen PASS. There is no mathematical blocker to proceeding prospectively with the frozen four-route, matched-budget single seed as a test of the same candidate. The short-screen cubic macro advantage over native was only 0.000551; linear had better CE and accuracy, and swapping the frozen cubic state to native or dephased improved macro. The +15 positive versus −18 no_relation correct-count tradeoff and 0/32 ceiling witnesses give no affirmative evidence that region escape drove the macro gain. Linear's structural null concerns unrestricted queries at fixed keys, not separately trained task scores. The full run can test the registered endpoint, but even a pass cannot by itself attribute the gain to nonabsorption, estimate across-seed stability, or supply independent population confirmation on the exposed split. Those are inference limits, not grounds to change the gate; runtime readiness is separate from this scientific judgment.
